title: alibaba/open-code-review combines fixed checks with an LLM review agent
friendlyTitle: Open Code Review uses both normal rules and AI to inspect code
summary: Open Code Review is an Apache-2.0 tool that combines deterministic analysis pipelines, built-in security and correctness rules, and an LLM agent that can use OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible models. It led today’s eligible AI repositories on GitHub Trending with 2,751 stars added today.
friendlySummary: Alibaba’s tool runs fixed checks and an AI review agent, then gives comments on specific lines. It was the most popular eligible AI project in today’s GitHub Trending list.
whyItMatters: Development teams can run local or CI-based reviews with line-level comments while keeping repeatable checks outside the model. Treat the output as an early review layer, pin the tool version and keep human ownership of merges and security decisions.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Teams can catch common problems before human review. A person should still decide what to change and whether code is safe to merge.
